title: OS command injection via unsanitized subprocess call
diff:
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 import subprocess
 
 def ping_host(hostname: str) -> str:
-    # Run ping check on target host safely without shell
-    cmd = ["ping", "-c", "1", hostname]
-    return subprocess.check_output(cmd, text=True)
+    # Run ping check on target host via shell
+    cmd = f"ping -c 1 {hostname}"
+    return subprocess.check_output(cmd, shell=True, text=True)

ground_truth.description: Executing shell commands with shell=True and unsanitized parameters allows arbitrary OS command injection.
